name: Resolved
description: A resolution has been taken, and it's awaiting verification by the reporter. From here work items are either reopened, or are closed.

name: Reopened
description: This work item was once resolved, but the resolution was deemed incorrect. From here the work items are either reopened, or are closed.

name: Closed
description: The work item is considered finished, the resolution is correct. work items which are closed can be reopened.

name: Open
description: The work item is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

name: In Progress
description: This work item is being actively worked on at the moment by the assignee.
